root_cause.text: The unmap_pages function in iommu_pt used the originally requested length (`len`) to set up the TLB invalidation gather, but when unmapping a large IOPTE that spans beyond the requested range, the actual unmapped size (`unmap.unmapped`) is larger, causing an incomplete flush of the extra unmapped pages.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `gather_range_pages(iotlb_gather, iommu_table, iova, len, &unmap.free_list)` to `gather_range_pages(iotlb_gather, iommu_table, iova, unmap.unmapped, &unmap.free_list)`, directly fixing the mismatch between the gather range and the actual unmapped range.

intent_record.how: Ensures gather_range_pages() uses the number of pages that were actually unmapped, not the originally requested length, preventing potential iotlb gather mismatches when the unmap operation unmaps fewer pages than requested.

candidates.rationale: This statement passes the originally requested length `len` to gather_range_pages, but when a large IOPTE spanning beyond the requested range is unmapped, the actual unmapped size (`unmap.unmapped`) is larger.
